scenes.caption: This is a test invoice for contributor work. Saving it does not approve a payment.
The recipient, token, amount and due time are the exact terms the owner reviews.
The Safe approves those terms on chain. The keeper cannot replace them later.
The owner sets allowed recipients and a daily cap. Pause stops new payments.
This preview uses a local keeper. It checks the approved terms before paying.
The receipt shows the actual payment. This invoice cannot be paid a second time.
The activity log keeps each attempt. Unknown sends wait for a receipt check.
The invoice and receipts can be exported together as a JSON record.
Local preview. The final release still needs a real KeeperHub transaction on Sepolia.
